{{Quote|Sensors detect a minor shift in local humidity. This organic needs to replace his pants.|Z0-0M, upon meeting Jollo|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Jollo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. At some point after [[3636 BBY]] he applied for a job as a [[Janitor/Legends|janitor]] for [[the Shroud's syndicate]], attracted by the benefits it offered. Though the job description required to remove his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and he had to pass through twenty interviews, Jollo eventually got the job, and was assigned to the volcano level of [[The Coil (Obus VI)|The Coil]], [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]'s latest base on [[Obus VI]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

In [[3630 BBY]], while cleaning the base with a [[vibromop]], Jollo encountered the droid [[HK-55]], who escaped the captivity and was in the process of tearing the place apart. Classified as non-combatant, Jollo was subdued and left tied up to a chair. The droid's rampage soon resulted in destruction of the underwater and the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] levels of the Coil, but Jollo survived on the volcano level, which was not affected. Eventually he was found by people [[Bey'wan Aygo]] sent to examine whether the rest of the base could be repurposed for the [[Eternal Alliance|Anti-Zakuul Alliance]]. Jollo was offered to join the Alliance and expressed the desire to eventually purchase the Coil for himself.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jollo appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the '''Interlude: Shroud of Memory'''. Players may decide to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him, in which case they will not receive him as a stronghold decoration.
